artifacts.text: Customers cannot self-resolve billing issues; every invoice or card problem requires an agent touch.
Several users have requested an export button on the reports screen.
Our compliance team needs an audit trail for every payment change before we can renew our contract.
I just want to see my invoices and fix card errors myself instead of emailing support every time.
Multiple customers report billing friction during checkout. Recommend UX investment next quarter.
Every Friday I copy about 200 rows from the reports screen into Excel by hand. It takes my whole morning and I make mistakes.
Add a bulk export button to the reports screen.
Redesign the checkout flow with a modern visual refresh to reduce billing friction.
Build the manual review queue for transactions of $20,000 or more.
Let customers view invoices, dispute charges and update payment details without contacting support.
Build an AI-powered onboarding assistant that guides new users through workspace setup.
This is very important to us since our users are spread throughout the USA in every timezone. We use date fields to determine the responsiveness (Mean time to respond) to an issue.
We are also seriously looking at Jira at the moment, and a major blocker for us is the lack of user timezones. We need follow the sun support for our support teams.
Finance policy: any transaction of $10,000 or more requires manual review before settlement.
I was charged twice and I can't find where to dispute it. This is the third time this month.
